searchText: MSRP $742,639. New 2026 Newmar Dutch Star 3836 for sale at Motor Home Specialist Features Bath & 1/2 Cathedral Ceiling in Rear Bath Special Exterior Colors 450HP Onguard Collision System Central Vacuum Dishwasher in a Drawer Dometic Freezer on Slides Monitor on Passenger Side Sirius Radio Capability Splendide Washer/Dryer Wifi Ranger Theater Seating Power Window Shades Premier Air Mattress Safe in Bedroom Kitchen Window More About This RV This luxurious and spacious Dutch Star Class A diesel motorhome is perfect for your family of six. The full rear bath features a cathedral ceiling with added height you are sure to appreciate, and the mid-coach half bath is great for your guests. The full-wall slide plus two additional slides provide ample interior space so that the kids can play with the dog on the floor. The kitchen also includes an all-electric flush mount induction cooktop, a stainless steel convection microwave with an air fryer feature, and a spacious Whirlpool 19.7 cu. ft. refrigerator for ample food storage. Whether you're dining at the free-standing dinette, taking a rest on the king bed slide, or enjoying some fresh air under the Girard G2000 power side awning with LED lights, you will fall in love with this home-on-wheels! Luxurious accommodations and elegant amenities are found in abundance on the Newmar Dutch Star Class A diesel motorhome! The interior features a tile floor, decorative wall art, hardwood raised panel doors, and MCD window shades. There are also super-polished solid-surface countertops, six-way power cab seats with recliner and footrest, and push-to-release drawer slides in the pantry. And the electric radiant heat installed below the main floor and bedroom tile is sure to bring comfort wherever you go! You'll find great convenience from the rearview color monitor system with audio, and there is a Bluetooth microphone for the dash radio. The roof has been prepped for a satellite dish, and the dash radio comes with a Harman/JBL 180W sound system and subwoofer.
